findings.issue: Qal תִמְעֹל plus cognate noun מַעַל license an unfaithful act/trespass. perpetrare perpetración keeps the cognate pair but drops that treachery and substitutes generic perpetration.

notes: Remaining tokens, including Jehová, 3fs then unmarked 3ms traerá, tú, and both אשם as culpa, stay within the packet.
